Data Scientist - NLP (Customer Insights)
Manchester or Leeds (hybrid) | Permanent | £42,000 - £52,000

Who we are
Brightwater Utilities supplies water and wastewater services to 2.4 million customers across the north of England. Our Customer Insights team turns what customers tell us - complaints, surveys, web chat transcripts, social media posts and call notes - into evidence that changes how the business operates. We are a friendly, supportive team of eight data scientists and analysts, and this role is a great opportunity for someone early in their data science career who wants to specialise in natural language processing.

The role
As a Data Scientist (NLP) you will build and maintain the text analytics models that classify and summarise around 100,000 pieces of customer feedback a month. You will work alongside a Senior Data Scientist who will support your development, and you will present findings to customer service managers and regulatory reporting colleagues. We use Python, scikit-learn, Hugging Face transformers and Azure.

Key responsibilities
- Build, evaluate and improve text classification models (topic, sentiment, complaint category) on customer feedback data.
- Clean and prepare messy free-text data: deduplication, PII redaction, language detection, tokenisation.
- Design and maintain labelled evaluation datasets with the customer service team, and report precision, recall and F1 clearly to non-technical colleagues.
- Prototype with pre-trained transformer models and sentence embeddings; compare against simpler baselines and justify the choice.
- Produce clear dashboards and written summaries of themes and trends in Power BI or Streamlit.
- Write reproducible, version-controlled code (Git) and contribute to the team's shared Python package.
- Support our regulatory reporting on customer experience measures (C-MeX) with robust analysis.

About you - essential
- A degree in a numerate subject (maths, statistics, computer science, physics, linguistics or similar) or equivalent experience.
- 1-3 years' experience in a data science or analytics role, or a strong portfolio of applied NLP projects.
- Good Python skills with pandas, scikit-learn and at least one NLP library (spaCy, NLTK or Hugging Face transformers).
- Understanding of core machine learning concepts: train/validation/test splits, cross-validation, over-fitting, class imbalance and evaluation metrics.
- Confident writing SQL to pull and join data.
- Able to explain technical work in plain English to non-technical stakeholders.
- Curious, organised and comfortable asking for help.

Desirable
- Experience with sentiment analysis, topic modelling (LDA, BERTopic) or text summarisation.
- Exposure to Azure (Azure ML, Databricks) or another cloud platform.
- Experience with Power BI or another BI tool.
- Knowledge of large language models and prompt-based approaches to text classification.
- Experience in a utilities, public sector or other regulated environment.

Benefits
- £42,000 - £52,000 depending on experience.
- 26 days' holiday plus bank holidays, rising with service.
- Generous pension (up to 12% employer contribution), health cash plan and cycle-to-work scheme.
- Hybrid working with two days a week in our Manchester or Leeds office.
- A structured development plan, mentoring and funded training.

Brightwater is a Disability Confident employer and welcomes applications from all backgrounds. Interviews will be held in the week commencing 6 October.
